title: Energizing Sour Ethiopian Cheese Custard
description: A sour and cheesy Ethiopian dish featuring a custard base, perfect for a low-carb breakfast or snack, with an energizing twist from the combination of ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine the eggs, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
In a skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the diced onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced green chili peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a greased 6-cup custard dish, arrange half of the crumbled sour ethiopian cheese in the bottom of the dish.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese in the custard dish.
Top the egg mixture with the sauteed onion and chili pepper mixture, followed by the remaining crumbled cheese.
Bake the custard in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
Remove the custard from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
To serve, use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the custard from the dish and transfer it to a plate, then use the spatula to fold the custard in half and create a cheesy pull.
Deglaze the skillet used for the onion and chili pepper mixture with a little water and pour the deglazed mixture over the custard as a sauce.
